finding.qualification: The final capture, physical-transport-double handoff export and calendar all bind H. The trace has no await or implicit Save between the mixed transient capture and final correction; no user-visible corruption, persisted bad browser draft or browser defect was established. The stronger contract nevertheless is not proved and should not be reported as passed.
finding.receiverLimit: The frozen source-aware receiver transparently recorded transient capture sources and asserted the final H capture; it did not assert the stronger every-capture invariant. Its 17/313 pass must be described with that exact limit.
finding.possibleCorrection: A narrow owner correction could retire acceptedPlan before committing the prepared handoff view, then assign the prepared origin as already done before final model/calendar/save refresh. This is a source proposal only; no product edit or rerun was performed.
